papers.title: Demystifying Agent Skills: Why They Work-Until They Don't
papers.abstract: Skills enhance LLM agents primarily by stabilizing execution through procedural anchoring rather than injecting missing knowledge, though retrieval bottlenecks and brittle assumptions limit their effectiveness.

papers.title: EDITBRIDGE: Towards Faithful and Efficient Ultra-High-Resolution Image Editing
papers.abstract: EditBridge enables efficient ultra high-resolution image editing via a diffusion bridge that translates low-resolution edits to high-resolution outputs while preserving source details through sparse attention.

papers.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: Towards Harnessed Agentic RL
papers.abstract: Agent Lightning v1.0 enables reproducible reinforcement learning for arbitrary agent harnesses, substantially improving coding-agent performance with minimal data and compute.

papers.title: DiSCO: Defending text-to-image generation through distribution-guided contrastive prompt optimization
papers.abstract: DiSCO is a black-box, zero-shot prompt-level defense that uses distribution-guided suffix expansion and contrastive scoring to reduce harmful image generation without altering the model.

papers.title: V-RAE: Rethinking Video Latent Spaces for Generation
papers.abstract: V-RAE constructs semantically organized video latents from frozen vision representations to improve generation quality, convergence speed, and predictive modeling.

papers.title: CoinVE-200K: A Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset for Compositional Instruction-Guided Video Editing
papers.abstract: A new dataset, benchmark, and 22B model enable compositional instruction-guided video editing with multi-region attention and temporal coherence.

papers.title: MoE-ViE: Mixture of Experts Vision Encoder for Efficient Image and Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts vision encoders with fine-grained topologies, auxiliary-loss-free balancing, and specialized kernels scale efficiently while outperforming larger dense models on image and video tasks.

papers.title: HarnessRisk: A Lifecycle-Oriented Benchmark for Agent Harness Safety
papers.abstract: HarnessRisk evaluates agent harness safety across six operational phases, revealing that configuration vulnerabilities and detection gaps allow high attack success despite preserved utility.

papers.title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement
papers.abstract: MathForm improves autoformalization by retrieving Mathlib knowledge and iteratively refining outputs with verification feedback, yielding a large verified dataset and a high-performing 8B model.

papers.title: Cross-Model Memory Transfer via Target-Side Reader Adaptation
papers.abstract: Cross-model reuse of frozen external memory tables depends primarily on aligning a lightweight target-side reader rather than the memory content alone, enabling reusable knowledge artifacts with optional adaptation.
